methodologyNotes: 13 notable smart locks selected as the 2026 buyer comparison set, covering the full spectrum a buyer evaluates: retrofit Bluetooth-only, Wi-Fi-native deadbolts, biometric deadbolts, Matter-over-Thread, and video-integrated locks. Seeds verified against manufacturer pages: August Wi-Fi Smart Lock (4th gen at august.com), Schlage Encode Plus and Encode (schlage.com), Schlage Sense Pro (schlage.com), Level Lock Pro / Level Lock / Level Bolt (level.co), Aqara U100 (aqara.com/en), Aqara U200 (us.aqara.com), Ultraloq U-Bolt Pro WiFi (u-tec.com), Lockly Vision Elite and Lockly Vision (lockly.com), Yale Assure Lock 2 (digitaltrends.com review — manufacturer yalehome.com returned HTTP 404 for all product URLs throughout the session; Digital Trends review quotes ~$160 Bluetooth / ~$240 Wi-Fi pricing). Yale Assure Lock 2's manufacturer page was unreachable; the best available published-review source was used and is noted in provenance. (Verifier note 2026-06-15: an earlier draft of this note mentioned a Eufy Smart Lock S230 seed that is NOT present in the products array and listed only 12 units; the array actually contains 13 products including Level Bolt — note reconciled.) specKeys chosen for comparability across all 12 units: unlock_methods (string, comma-separated list of access methods), connectivity (string, radio protocols the lock itself supports), matter (boolean, whether the lock natively supports the Matter standard), auto_lock (boolean, configurable auto-lock feature), battery_type (string, primary battery format), finish_options (string, comma-separated color/finish options), install_type (string, how the lock mounts), release (YYYY or YYYY-MM). priceUsd = US MSRP / starting price in USD for the base/reference configuration, confirmed from manufacturer page or reputable retail coverage; priceUsd=null when no USD price could be verified from any source. accessedAt 2026-06-15 on all entries.

No Apple Home Key on standard Level Lock (that is a Level Lock Pro / Bolt feature). Auto-lock not confirmed — marked false (conservative). Exterior appearance unchanged. Wi-Fi via optional Level Connect bridge. CORRECTION (verifier 2026-06-15): matter changed true→null. Level's own communications and review coverage (level.co/matter-update; notebookcheck Matter rollout) state Matter-over-Thread firmware shipped first to Level Lock+ and Level Bolt, and that owners of the ORIGINAL Level Lock / Level Lock Touch 'will still require the WiFi adaptor since those locks are yet to support Matter.' The original 2019 Level Lock is hardware-compatible but native Matter support for this specific SKU could not be confirmed — set null per verifier policy rather than asserting true.
